# nextflow-workflow-engine

## What it does

Scalable bioinformatics workflows with Nextflow and nf-core — pipeline structure, execution and
common patterns.

## When to use / when not

Use when building or running Nextflow/nf-core pipelines.

This is a third-party skill from SciAgent-Skills, not maintained in this repository.

## Install

```bash
npx skills add jaechang-hits/SciAgent-Skills@nextflow-workflow-engine
```

## Install in Claude Science

**Skills → Add skill → Import from GitHub**, then paste:

```
https://github.com/HelmholtzAI-Consultants-Munich/helmholtz-agent-skills
```

That installs the curated `nextflow` plugin, not the whole SciAgent-Skills repository.
[Walkthrough](../claude-science.md).
